ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

2. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Hadith intention the choice of friends? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Hadith intention the choice of friends.
   B. Apply the teaching of Selected Hadith intention the choice of friends with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Selected Hadith intention the choice of friends to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Selected Hadith intention the choice of friends has no place in daily life.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Chapters 90:1? (1 mark)
   A. Say Selected Chapters 90:1 has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Selected Chapters 90:1 with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Chapters 90:1.
   D. Use Selected Chapters 90:1 to insult classmates of other faiths.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Ulumul Hadith Hadith of Hadith Hadith Hadith? (1 mark)
   A. Say Ulumul Hadith Hadith of Hadith Hadith Hadith has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Ulumul Hadith Hadith of Hadith Hadith Hadith to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Ulumul Hadith Hadith of Hadith Hadith Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ulumul Hadith Hadith of Hadith Hadith Hadith.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Significance of Tawhid? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Significance of Tawhid with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Significance of Tawhid has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Significance of Tawhid.
   D. Use Significance of Tawhid to insult classmates of other faiths.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Dimensions of Morality in Islam 04 5.2 Virtues in Islam 05 5.3 Prohibitions in I? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Dimensions of Morality in Islam 04 5.2 Virtues in Islam 05 5.3 Prohibitions in I.
   B. Apply the teaching of Dimensions of Morality in Islam 04 5.2 Virtues in Islam 05 5.3 Prohibitions in I with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Dimensions of Morality in Islam 04 5.2 Virtues in Islam 05 5.3 Prohibitions in I to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Dimensions of Morality in Islam 04 5.2 Virtues in Islam 05 5.3 Prohibitions in I has no place in daily life.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Shirk of Shirk Shirk? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Shirk of Shirk Shirk.
   B. Apply the teaching of Shirk of Shirk Shirk with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Shirk of Shirk Shirk to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Shirk of Shirk Shirk has no place in daily life.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Saum ,? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Saum , with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Saum , has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Saum ,.
   D. Use Saum , to insult classmates of other faiths.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Swalah prayers occasions (Swalatul, Janaza, Musafir, Kusuf, and Khusuf),? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Swalah prayers occasions (Swalatul, Janaza, Musafir, Kusuf, and Khusuf), with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Swalah prayers occasions (Swalatul, Janaza, Musafir, Kusuf, and Khusuf), to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Swalah prayers occasions (Swalatul, Janaza, Musafir, Kusuf, and Khusuf), has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Swalah prayers occasions (Swalatul, Janaza, Musafir, Kusuf, and Khusuf),.

10. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Care for the environment and use resources wisely

11. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

12. Which response best shows understanding of Dimensions of Morality in Islam? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Dimensions of Morality in Islam.
   B. Use Dimensions of Morality in Islam to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Dimensions of Morality in Islam has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Dimensions of Morality in Islam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Dimensions of Morality in Islam and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Virtues in Islam 05 5.3 Prohibitions in Islam 08 6 Muamalat 6.1 Marriage 06 6.2  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Virtues in Islam and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Prohibitions in Islam and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

7. B — Apply the teaching of Shirk of Shirk Shirk with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. A — Apply the teaching of Saum , with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Virtues in Islam; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Prohibitions in Islam; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
